verdict.rationale: Proa documents composable, typed Rust components with compile-time-checked props, vendored into src/components/. Every render also gets typed access to request-scoped data through a shared WebContext, which is a context-passing mechanism rather than documented dependency injection. Modular building blocks are evidenced, but true DI is only weakly implied. Missing for 10: explicit dependency-injection or service-provider mechanism, module or plugin organization docs beyond components, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can organize my app into modular, dependency-injected building blocks

citations.quote: Source in your repo, in typed Rust. Theme it, compose it, ship it.
